transformation_scope.base_catalog: All 311 consolidated lead rows and 62 provider/protocol profiles are copied as `source_record` objects into separate collections; no source rows edited.
transformation_scope.regional_inputs: All 20 offer objects, 2 existing-record enrichment objects, and 25 country/market sweep objects are extracted from the three source JSON files and preserved exactly as parsed JSON values. The rest of the source envelopes are not copied; source hashes preserve provenance.
transformation_scope.routes: Eight browser workflow routes are included unchanged as route records and joined only by exact catalog_id. Workflow report Markdown is listed as a documentation reference but is not copied into the database folder.
transformation_scope.route_spec: The 62-record catalog coverage index is included as an exact route-spec crosswalk only; pending records do not become provider-specific instructions or approvals.
transformation_scope.path_metadata: Local-only path metadata inside the three regional source envelopes is excluded from this derived output; selected record values, IDs, cited URLs, check dates and unknowns are retained.
transformation_scope.csv: Flat export contains one row for every lead/profile/offer record, preserving record kind/status and separate source collection; nested facts are compact JSON strings.

quality_validation.scope: JSON schema, source-record/hash reconciliation, counts, exact foreign keys, citations, local links, public-safe path/secret pattern scan; not an evidence re-audit or operational test.
